commitments.detail: Ben will serve as the primary point of contact for new hires and managers, ensuring smooth integration into the onboarding process.
Recurring meetings will start at 10 AM to accommodate all stakeholders and ensure regular updates on the onboarding initiative.
A two-person review team will be established to handle sensitive cases, ensuring confidentiality and thoroughness.
An official written escalation route will be documented to provide clear steps for addressing issues and concerns.
